gemini-2.5-flash.standardized_narrative: For the 2018 financial year, Syndicate 2689 experienced a gross prior year reserve strengthening of $22.181 million, representing a 51.26% increase relative to the opening gross claims outstanding. This strengthening primarily impacted the 2017 underwriting year, which was a whole account quota share treaty. The deterioration was largely attributed to adverse claims development stemming from natural catastrophe events, including Hurricanes Harvey, Irma, and Maria, as well as earthquakes in Mexico and wildfires in California, which occurred in 2017.

gpt-5-mini.standardized_narrative: The Syndicate opened 2018 with gross claims outstanding of 33.985 million (USD). During 2018 reserves deteriorated primarily due to catastrophe losses related to the 2017 underwriting account and further catastrophe activity in late 2018 (notably US hurricanes and Californian wildfires). The movement is described as a deterioration/strengthening of prior year reserves driven by catastrophe losses on the AxaXL whole account quota share, however the report does not provide an explicit aggregate gross prior-year development figure in the notes and therefore a quantified gross prior year development amount is not available.

gpt-5-mini.data_quality_notes: No explicit 'movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' gross figure is provided in the notes; the technical provisions reconciliation shows aggregate change in claims outstanding (gross) but that includes current year movements. The claims development table contains only the two most recent underwriting years (2017 and 2018) so it cannot be used to compute a reliable aggregated prior-year development for years earlier than 2017. Consequently the gross prior-year development amount is not available from the report and is reported as null. All monetary figures are taken from the financial statements presented in USD (amounts in the source are in $'000 and converted here to millions).
